description.value:
Prerequisites: Ki Trap blitz technique

Detonate your Ki Trap, damaging nearby creatures. As an immediate action, you may detonate your Ki Trap, dealing non-elemental damage equal to 1d6 per monk level to creatures within its area of effect. A successful Reflex save (DC: 10 + half of your monk level + your Constitution modifier) halves this damage. The Ki Trap is destroyed after detonation.
